description: Create a snapshot of a Search Engine Service cluster. ⚠️ Prerequisite chain: ncloud_ses_set_snapshot_api_key → ncloud_ses_get_snapshot_buckets → this tool. Without the API key the bucket lookup fails with 10115.

bucketName.description: Object Storage bucket to store the snapshot in (from ncloud_ses_get_snapshot_buckets)

name: ncloud_ses_create_snapshot
